scope.name: Visual Garment Preview
in_scope: connect the live FDE semantic garment draft to existing Multiversal character appearance/presentation rendering seams for visible garment preview
render deterministic full-body, portrait and token garment views from the current FGA-PARAM-1 garment state without introducing a second garment or renderer authority
respect FGA-02 topology anchors, clearances, masks, occlusion and compatible/unresolved/incompatible fit diagnostics across ordinary and difficult body topologies
reflect FDE-02 material, pattern, trim, palette, layer and length control changes in the visual preview
preserve provider-off operation and explicit unsupported/missing primitive diagnostics rather than silently inventing missing topology coverage
focused cross-platform visual-state/runtime tests proving semantic edits and view changes drive the intended preview state
out_of_scope: FDE-04 durable design persistence, collections or version storage
FDE-06 PAPT asset realization, generative asset synthesis or paid production execution
new garment semantics or a new rendering authority
Oaran fashion houses, eras or cultural style catalogs
Mall, marketplace, commerce or public sharing
equipment ownership/stats, anatomy or mechanics mutation
